show.description: At her own engagement party, Ananya Joshi uncovers her fiancé Rohan Rathore’s betrayal with her cousin Rhea. Determined to reclaim her power and dignity, she forms an unlikely alliance with the ruthless tycoon Vikram Singh Rathore, Rohan’s formidable uncle. But as their revenge game turns into a whirlwind of power, passion, and family warfare, Ananya must choose between vengeance and love in a battle that could destroy them all. Watch Now!
